products.name: Moveworks
products.note: Employee support automation; IT service desk agent; enterprise-grade access controls

profile_text.body:
Moveworks describes itself as an AI assistant platform designed to help enterprise workforces find answers and automate tasks across business applications. The platform supports over 100 languages and connects to more than 50 systems, including Slack, OneDrive, Google Drive, SharePoint, Confluence, and Outlook. Employees can access it through chat, web, intranet, portals, and mobile interfaces. The company notes a partnership with ServiceNow, and the two are evaluated together as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI Applications in IT Service Management. Moveworks was also named a Challenger in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Artificial Intelligence Applications in IT Service Management as a standalone entry.

The core technical component is the Moveworks Reasoning Engine, which the company describes as an agentic AI system that orchestrates enterprise-ready large language models and built-in tools to autonomously understand, plan, execute, and adapt to workplace requests. The platform offers hundreds of plugins and connectors, low-code and vibe-code tool builders, and analytics for platform management. One customer quote references a healthcare organization with 300,000 colleagues serving 185 million people, citing compliance, security, and the automation of repetitive tasks across IT, HR, and procurement as key goals. Shrini Arole from Toyota is quoted describing the platform as easy to implement with both generative AI and automation capabilities.

The site's own data indicates that 78 percent of executives report major operational transformation with frontline employees leading the charge, drawn from a report the company references. The held facts list Moveworks as a single tracked product in the Enterprise AI Platforms and Agent Orchestration category, with noted capabilities in employee support automation, IT service desk agents, and enterprise-grade access controls. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings are recorded for the company.
